description: Plano de Mobilidade Elétrica Municipal is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Santa Cruz das Flores. The Municipal Electric Mobility Plan of Santa Cruz das Flores (2020-2026) defines the local strategy for the promotion of electric mobility in the municipality. Coverage: Santa Cruz das Flores. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal Electric Mobility Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Santa Cruz das Flores. Its keywords include mobilidade-eletrica, energia, mobilidade-sustentavel, veiculos-eletricos, santa-cruz-das-flores. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2025-11-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
